title: A nonlinear Li-Yau inequality and its consequences
summary:
We prove a sharp nonlinear analogue of the Li-Yau inequality for positive solutions of the normalized parabolic $p$-Laplacian equation \[ u_t = Δu + (p-2)|
abla u|^{-2}
abla^2u(
abla u,
abla u),\ \ \ 1<p<\infty, \] on a closed Riemannian manifold with nonnegative Ricci curvature, the equation being interpreted in the viscosity sense on the critical set of the solution. We also derive a sharp global Harnack inequality from the gradient estimate. The constant is best possible.
